scenes.title: Pizza Satellites and Fivefold Budgets
scenes.summary: The video chain Proprietor warns Kawada they need a true flagship hit like Kuroki again, while Muranishi demonstrates satellite broadcasting with pizza and demands fivefold budgets.

scenes.title: Nonstop Shooting Loop
scenes.summary: Kawada hands out cash envelopes as Muranishi directs back-to-back scenes across rooms and suddenly drafts his shy assistant director to step in as the male actor.

scenes.title: Ten Million Yen for Freshness
scenes.summary: When an on-set mishap during the assistant's debut infuriates the lead actress, Muranishi apologizes and offers ten million yen on the spot to turn it into a brand-new genre.

scenes.title: A Diamond in the Rough on the Street
scenes.summary: After the chain Proprietor toasts Muranishi's booming new trend at a club, Kawada drops a tape on the sidewalk and spots a quiet young woman who could surpass Kuroki.

scenes.title: Scouting Newcomers vs Celebrity Gossip
scenes.summary: At a barbecue dinner, Kawada urges scouting fresh talent while an actress's story about a famous pop singer inspires Muranishi to film a true-story celebrity gossip hit.

scenes.title: Toshi's Botched Badger Game
scenes.summary: Working for Furuya's yakuza outfit, Toshi lets an elected politician escape a hotel blackmail trap, takes a beating from a senior gangster, and receives cash from Furuya.
scenes.location: hotel room and Furuya syndicate office

scenes.title: Not Cut Out for the Underworld
scenes.summary: At a hostess club, Toshi begs Furuya to spare him from returning to adult videos, then walks hostess Mama home as she tells him he isn't suited to yakuza life.

scenes.title: Flood of Reorders and Station Apologies
scenes.summary: While reorders swamp the understaffed office and Muranishi agrees to buy a resort villa, Kawada bows deeply to television producers to keep Muranishi on the air.

scenes.title: Storming Out of the Television Studio
scenes.summary: Dropped from a broadcast over his idol gossip video, Muranishi pulls Kuroki off the show too and taunts the pop idol in the hallway, leaving Kawada to apologize again.

scenes.title: Four Simultaneous Releases
scenes.summary: Kawada pleads with Muranishi to shoot an artistic film with Kuroki again, yet Muranishi opens a secret celebrity tip line and launches four simultaneous gossip titles.

scenes.title: Nostalgia Late at Night
scenes.summary: Takei warns Kawada that Muranishi's films are on the verge of a distribution ban, and late at night Kuroki tells Kawada she still hopes to film with Muranishi again.

scenes.title: One Billion Yen Recalled
scenes.summary: At a party celebrating one billion yen in sales, Muranishi pledges every yen to satellite TV—until Kawada announces he recalled and discontinued the entire series.

scenes.title: Follow the Leader You Trust
scenes.summary: Kawada threatens to fire Muranishi unless he shoots a true film with Kuroki, and Muranishi challenges the staff to choose between Kawada's caution and his satellite dream.
